note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its proposed derivation from עִי, “heap of ruins,” is uncertain.
summary: Ai lay east of Bethel. Abram pitched his tent between the two places, with Ai to his east.

senses.definition: The town east of Bethel that marks the eastern side of Abram’s campsite.

evidence.note: Bethel is west of the tent and Ai is east of it.
Joshua sends men from Jericho to Ai, which the verse locates east of Bethel.
